# violating conditionality principle


 
```{r echo=FALSE}

vars.init = c(0.4, 3) ####    Small, and large. so power is large, Small.
div(
  numericInput('varsBig', 'varsBig', value = vars.init[2]),
  numericInput('varsSmall', 'varsSmall', value = vars.init[1])
)

```
```{r}
varsBig = reactive({input$varsBig})
output[['varsBig.text']] = renderText({varsBig()})   # OK.
vBtext = function()textOutput( 'varsBig.text', inline=TRUE)  ##OK
```
```{r}
varsSmall = reactive({input$varsSmall})
output[['varsSmall.text']] = renderText({varsSmall()})   # OK.
vStext = function()textOutput( 'varsSmall.text', inline=TRUE)  ##OK
```
```{r}
makeReactiveVariable = parse(text="
  Nname = 'varsSmall'
  Nassign = paste0(
    'reactive({', 'input$', Nname, '})' ) 
  print(Nassign)
  Nreactive = paste0(Nname, '.text')
  cat('(Nreactive)\n')
  print((Nreactive))  ### ok.
  assign(Nreactive, eval(parse(text= Nassign) ) , 
         envir = parent.frame(2))
  cat('get(Nreactive)\n')

")
```
